name: Hover Highlight Nav
description: A soft background highlight glides between nav items under the pointer or keyboard focus and fades out when you leave.
a11y: Works with keyboard focus; links stay native.
prompt: Build a nav whose hovered/focused item gets a rounded background highlight rendered with a scoped layoutId (snappy spring) that fades in/out via AnimatePresence when entering/leaving the group.

name: Morphing Mega Menu
description: Stripe-style dropdown: one shared panel morphs its size between menus and slides content in the direction you move.
a11y: Triggers are buttons with aria-expanded/controls; opens on focus; Esc closes.
prompt: Create a morphing mega menu: one absolutely positioned panel container with Motion `layout` so its width/height spring between menu contents; contents swap with popLayout sliding ±40px in the direction of travel (compare with the previous index); open on hover/focus, close on leave/Esc.

name: Collapsible Sidebar
description: App sidebar that springs between full width and an icon rail, with a gliding active indicator, badges and native tooltips.
a11y: aria-current on the active item; collapsed items keep aria-label + title.
perf: Width spring on one element; labels fade.
prompt: Build a collapsible sidebar: width springs 232↔68px; labels fade/slide (delayed on expand, instant on collapse); active item highlighted by a layoutId pill; badges move to the icon corner when collapsed; toggle button rotates its icon 180°.

name: Bottom Tab Bar
description: Mobile bottom tab bar where a pill slides to the active tab, its icon bounces and its label expands inline.
a11y: tablist/tab roles with aria-selected; labels available to screen readers.
prompt: Create a floating bottom bar: tabs are icon buttons; the active one gets a layoutId pill background, its icon plays y [0,−5,0] + rotate [0,−10,0], and its label expands from width 0 to auto beside the icon.

name: Speed Dial FAB
description: Floating action button that blooms into a radial or vertical set of actions with staggered bouncy springs.
a11y: aria-expanded on the FAB; actions labelled; Esc closes.
prompt: Build a speed dial: a FAB whose plus rotates 135° when open; actions spring from the FAB center to positions on a 150° arc above it (radius 88px) or a vertical stack, staggered 40ms with a bouncy spring, collapsing in reverse.

name: Animated Breadcrumb
description: Breadcrumb where new segments slide in, removed ones collapse, and long paths fold the middle into an ellipsis.
a11y: nav aria-label=Breadcrumb, ordered list, aria-current on the last item.
perf: Layout animation on a handful of items.
prompt: Create animated breadcrumbs: when the path exceeds `max`, render first + '…' + last (max−2); each li uses layout + popLayout to slide in from x 12 and collapse out; last item is a highlighted aria-current pill.

name: Morphing Popover
description: A button that morphs (shared layout) into a panel — feedback forms, quick-add, share sheets.
a11y: Panel is a labelled dialog; Esc and click-outside close; focus moves into the form.
prompt: Build a morphing popover: the trigger button and the panel share a layoutId (and the label shares one with the panel title) inside AnimatePresence popLayout, so clicking stretches the pill into the card; content fades in after 120ms; Esc/outside click reverse it.

name: Context Menu
description: Right-click menu that scales from the click point with staggered items, shortcuts and full arrow-key navigation.
a11y: Opens with Shift+F10 / Menu key too; role=menu/menuitem; focus moves in; arrows and Esc work.
prompt: Create a context menu: on contextmenu (or Shift+F10) open a role=menu at the pointer clamped inside the area, scale .9→1 from top-left with a stiff spring, items stagger in 25ms; arrow keys cycle focus, Enter selects, Esc/scroll/outside click close.

name: Hover Card
description: Rich preview card that springs up from a link after a short hover-intent delay — profiles and link previews.
a11y: Opens on focus too; aria-describedby links trigger and card; moving into the card keeps it open.
prompt: Build a hover card: after a 350ms hover intent (or immediately on focus) show a card below the trigger that springs from y 6 / scale .96; a 120ms close delay lets the pointer travel into the card, which cancels closing.

name: Command Palette
description: ⌘K palette that springs open, filters and groups commands, with a highlight gliding between results.
a11y: Dialog with combobox input and listbox options; ↑/↓/Enter/Esc; ⌘K toggles.
perf: Filtering is in-memory; layout animation for the list.
props: { id, label, group, icon?, shortcut?, run? }[]
prompt: Create a ⌘K command palette: blurred backdrop, dialog that springs from scale .95/y −10, search input acting as a combobox, results grouped under small headings, a layoutId highlight following the selected index (mouse or arrows), Enter runs the command and closes.

name: Before / After Slider
description: Drag the handle — or use the arrow keys, it's a real slider — to wipe between two images.
a11y: Handle is role=slider with aria-valuenow and arrow-key support; both images have alt text.
prompt: Build an image comparison: stack two images; clip the top one with inset(0 (100−pos)% 0 0); pointer down/move (with pointer capture) sets pos from the x position; a vertical line + round handle (role=slider, ←/→ by 5%) sits at pos.

name: Cover Flow
description: Classic 3D cover flow: the centered item faces you while neighbours rotate away in perspective.
a11y: listbox with options; ←/→ keys; click any cover to focus it.
perf: Transforms on visible items; far items fade out.
prompt: Create cover flow with perspective 1100px: item offset o = n − i; centered item at z 80, rotateY 0; others at x = o·70 ± 70, z −|o|·40, rotateY −sign(o)·58°, springs; drag/keys/clicks change the index; reflection under each cover.

name: Shared-Layout Lightbox
description: Click a thumbnail and it flies into a fullscreen lightbox; browse with arrows or keys, Esc returns it home.
a11y: aria-modal dialog with alt text, labelled controls, ←/→/Esc keys, focus to Close.
perf: Shared layoutId between grid tile and full image.
prompt: Build a lightbox: grid tiles and the fullscreen image share a layoutId per index so opening morphs the tile into place; dark backdrop; prev/next buttons and ←/→ keys swap the index; Esc or backdrop click morphs it back.

name: Video Hover Preview
description: Card that plays a muted preview on hover/focus — or a Ken Burns pan without video — with a progress line.
a11y: Plays on focus too; videos are muted and never autoplay sound; reduced motion keeps the poster still.
perf: preload=none; pauses and rewinds on leave.
prompt: Create a video hover card: on pointerenter/focus play a muted looping <video preload=none>; on leave pause and reset currentTime; fallback without src: slow scale/translate Ken Burns on the poster; a red progress bar scales X over 4s while previewing.

name: Masonry Reveal
description: Pinterest-style masonry whose tiles rise and unblur in a staggered wave as they scroll into view.
a11y: Real images with alt; reduced motion shows them immediately.
perf: CSS columns layout; whileInView once per tile.
prompt: Build a masonry gallery with CSS columns; each figure (break-inside avoid) enters with y 40 + blur 8 → rest when in view, delayed by its column index × 80ms; images zoom slightly on hover.
